description: Defines the IUserRepository interface, an abstraction for user persistence operations such as retrieving users by username or email, and adding new users.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: An interface defining user repository operations, including methods for fetching users and adding new users.

methods.name: GetByUserNameAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user by username.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user by email.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new user to the repository.
